name: Mirror City
description: On a city avenue at blue hour, the skyline doubles upside down across the whole sky.

wardrobe.man: a long dark navy coat and dark clothes
wardrobe.woman: a long dark navy coat and dark clothes
wardrobe.person: a long dark navy coat and dark clothes

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} stands in the middle of a wide empty city avenue at blue hour, seen from behind, looking up at the sky ahead, wearing {wardrobe}. Rows of lit office towers line both sides and converge toward the horizon, the wet asphalt reflects the lights, and the sky is a clear deep blue. Low-angle wide shot from behind at waist height, the {subject} centered and small, the avenue and the open sky filling the frame. Cinematic photography, blue hour light, warm window lights. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, blank facades and plain lit windows throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands in the avenue looking up. The sky fills with a second city: an exact mirrored copy of the skyline rises from the horizon and hangs upside down over the whole sky, its towers pointing down toward the street, its windows lit, its streets and cars moving overhead, the two cities facing each other like reflections across the air, until by the last second the inverted city covers the entire sky above the {subject}. The camera tilts up slowly from the {subject} to the city overhead. Sound: a deep low rumble of shifting concrete, a soft metallic groan, a wide airy hum. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, seamless architectural mirroring with consistent perspective, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The sky fills with a second world: an exact mirrored copy of the surroundings rises from the horizon and hangs upside down over the whole sky, facing the ground like a reflection across the air, until by the last second the inverted world covers the entire sky above the {subject}. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a deep low rumble, a soft metallic groan, a wide airy hum. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, seamless mirroring with consistent perspective, sharp detail, stable picture.
